summary: The requirement document describes a platform for a trucking company's office team, drivers and business customers. It covers trip planning, live truck tracking, an Android driver app with parcel scanning and proof of delivery, fuel and service tracking, expense approval, GST freight invoices sent to Tally, and reports. The vendor supports it for three years.

evidence.quote: Drivers shall use an Android app to see their trips, start and finish each stop, and call the customer.

stories: As a driver, I can see my trips in the Android app
As a driver, I can start and finish each stop
As a driver, I can call the customer

evidence.quote: Dispatchers and customers shall see trucks live on a map, with the expected arrival time at each stop.

stories: As a dispatcher, I can see trucks live on a map
As a customer, I can see trucks live on a map
As a customer, I can see the expected arrival time at each stop

evidence.quote: Drivers shall scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery with the phone camera.

stories: As a driver, I can scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery with the phone camera

evidence.quote: The driver app shall keep working on highways without mobile network and send the data when the network returns.

stories: As a driver, I can keep using the app without mobile network and have my data sent when the network returns

evidence.quote: Customers shall receive an SMS with a tracking link when their parcel is out for delivery.

stories: As a customer, I get an SMS with a tracking link when my parcel is out for delivery
